mitre_mappings.justification: The bot is a malware program developed as a capability, matching the development of malware.
T1683.001 (Written Content) directly corresponds to developing email content for phishing, a resource development activity.

veris_to_mitre.notes: The capability 'Email' under value_chain.development refers to developing an email for phishing, which aligns with the ATT&CK technique for developing written content.

mitre_mappings.justification: Directly corresponds to developing exploit code as a capability.
Directly corresponds to obtaining exploit code as a capability.

veris_to_mitre.notes: The capability focuses on developing or obtaining exploit code, which aligns with resource-development techniques for exploits.

mitre_mappings.justification: Exploit kits are a capability to develop or acquire exploits, aligning with the development of exploit capabilities.
Exploit kits involve obtaining or using pre-existing exploits, matching the acquisition of exploit capabilities.

veris_to_mitre.notes: The capability explicitly states that no development was necessary, so no ATT&CK techniques are mapped.
The 'Other' variety under value_chain.development indicates a development activity not covered by specific listed types. The most direct mapping is to the general Develop Capabilities technique.

mitre_mappings.justification: Developing a malicious payload corresponds to developing malware capabilities.
Obtaining a malicious payload corresponds to obtaining malware capabilities.

veris_to_mitre.notes: The payload is a malicious program, so it maps to malware development and acquisition techniques.

mitre_mappings.justification: Establishing accounts is the core action for creating a fake persona.
Fake social media profiles are explicitly mentioned in the description.
Email accounts can also be used to create a fake persona, though not explicitly stated.

veris_to_mitre.notes: The capability focuses on creating fake personas, primarily via social media accounts. T1585 and T1585.001 are direct matches; T1585.002 is included as a common alternative for persona creation.
No ATT&CK technique directly corresponds to the development of physical devices such as skimmers.

mitre_mappings.justification: Le développement de ransomware implique la création de malware, correspondant à Develop Capabilities: Malware.
L'acquisition de ransomware existant correspond à Obtain Capabilities: Malware.

veris_to_mitre.notes: Mapping basé sur le développement de capacités de ransomware (value_chain.development). Les techniques d'impact comme T1486 et T1490 ne sont pas incluses car elles représentent l'utilisation, non le développement.

mitre_mappings.justification: Development of trojan malware aligns with developing malware capabilities.
Obtaining trojan malware aligns with obtaining malware capabilities.

veris_to_mitre.notes: T1036 Masquerading is related but not included as it is a technique used by the trojan, not the development capability.

mitre_mappings.justification: Development investment may involve developing capabilities, as per resource development.
Development investment may also involve obtaining capabilities, as per resource development.

veris_to_mitre.notes: The development investment is unknown in type, so both developing and obtaining capabilities are plausible.

mitre_mappings.justification: Developing a full website is a form of staging capabilities for malicious operations.
